title: Access Widget Inside a Partial
explanation: Fetches the widget named 'coreAppsList' from a Partial loaded in 'containerSelectCoreProject'.

title: Add or Remove Class on Widget DOM
explanation: Adds or removes a CSS class to the DOM element of 'mdApplicationTypeList' widget using nativeElement.

title: Click Handler Inside List/Card Items
explanation: Executes a click event on a button inside a List item. Uses `item` for data and `currentItemWidgets` to manipulate inner widgets.

title: Disable Wizard Step Next Button
explanation: Disables the 'Next' button in the wizard named 'wizardCreatePrefab' using jQuery.

title: Set Localized Caption for a Label
explanation: Uses app-level i18n translation key to set the caption of a label in a Partial.

title: Pass Parameters to Partial via Container
explanation: Page assigns 'test1' to container's `pageParams`. The Partial accesses `Partial.pageParams.test1` for use in variable calls.
